Social Media Video Strategy for SaaS: Platform-by-Platform Guide

Each platform has its own rules. Here's how to create video content that actually works for each, specifically for B2B SaaS companies.

The Social Video Landscape for SaaS

Not all platforms are equal for B2B SaaS. Let's be honest about where to invest:

Platform B2B SaaS Priority Best For
LinkedIn 🟢 High B2B reach, thought leadership
YouTube 🟢 High SEO, evergreen content, tutorials
Twitter/X 🟡 Medium Tech audience, quick tips, releases
TikTok 🟡 Medium Brand awareness, younger audience
Instagram 🟠 Lower Culture, hiring, visual brands

Rule of thumb: Start with LinkedIn and YouTube. Add other platforms only when you've nailed those first.

💼 LinkedIn Video

Optimal length: 30-90 seconds (feed), up to 10 min (articles)

Aspect ratio: 1:1 (square) or 4:5 (vertical performs best)

Resolution: 1080x1080 or 1080x1350

Captions: Essential (85% watch muted)

What Works on LinkedIn

  • Native video: 5x more reach than links to YouTube
  • Founder/exec videos: Personal brands outperform company pages
  • Hot takes: Industry opinions that spark discussion
  • Behind the scenes: Product development, team culture
  • Quick tips: Actionable advice in 60 seconds

Content Ideas for SaaS

"One feature we almost killed—and why we kept it"
"The biggest mistake I see [roles] make with [your category]"
"3 things I wish I knew before building [product]"
"Customer question we get 10x a day (and the answer)"

LinkedIn Video Best Practices

  • Post from personal accounts, not company page
  • Start with text hook above the video
  • Hook in first 3 seconds (viewer keeps scrolling otherwise)
  • Ask a question at the end to drive comments
  • Reply to every comment within first hour

📺 YouTube Video

Optimal length: 8-15 minutes (SEO sweet spot)

Aspect ratio: 16:9 (horizontal)

Resolution: 1920x1080 or 3840x2160

Thumbnail: Critical (1280x720, faces perform best)

What Works on YouTube

  • Tutorials: "How to [solve problem with your product]"
  • Comparisons: "[Your product] vs [competitor]" (people search this)
  • Industry education: Position yourself as the authority
  • Customer stories: Case study video format
  • Webinar recordings: Repurpose long-form content

Content Ideas for SaaS

"Complete [Category] Tutorial for Beginners (2025)"
"[Your Product] vs [Competitor]: Honest Comparison"
"How [Customer] Grew Revenue 50% Using [Product]"
"5 [Category] Mistakes That Are Costing You [Metric]"

YouTube SEO Tips

  • Research keywords with TubeBuddy or vidIQ
  • Put keyword in title, description, and filename
  • Create 3-4 minute "Shorts" from long videos
  • Aim for 50%+ watch time retention
  • Add timestamps/chapters for longer videos

🐦 Twitter/X Video

Optimal length: 15-45 seconds

Aspect ratio: 1:1 or 16:9

Resolution: 1280x720 minimum

File size: Up to 512MB

What Works on Twitter/X

  • Quick product demos: "New feature 🧵" with video
  • Screen recordings: "Here's how to [quick win]"
  • Hot takes on video: Controversial opinion + face
  • Launch announcements: Product Hunt-style teasers
  • Clips from podcasts: Best 30-second moments

Twitter Video Tips

  • Always add captions—most scroll muted
  • Start with high-energy hook
  • Pair with thread for context
  • Tag relevant people (sparingly)
  • Post during high-engagement hours (8-10am, 5-7pm)

🎵 TikTok Video

Optimal length: 15-60 seconds (60-90 for storytelling)

Aspect ratio: 9:16 (vertical only)

Resolution: 1080x1920

Hook: First 1 second determines everything

Should SaaS Be on TikTok?

Maybe. TikTok works for SaaS when:

  • Your audience includes younger professionals (25-35)
  • Your product has visual appeal
  • You have someone willing to be the "face"
  • You're okay with brand awareness (not direct conversions)

What Works on TikTok for B2B

  • Day in the life: What working at a SaaS startup looks like
  • Myth-busting: "Nobody tells you this about [industry]"
  • Quick tutorials: "How to [thing] in 30 seconds"
  • Trend participation: Apply trending sounds to your niche
  • Reaction videos: React to industry news or competitor content

TikTok Tips

  • Post 1-3 times per day minimum
  • Use trending sounds (check Creative Center)
  • Hook in first 0.5 seconds or you're dead
  • Be authentic—polished content underperforms
  • Engage with comments immediately after posting

The Content Repurposing System

One piece of content can become 10+ social videos. Here's the system:

  1. Create one long-form piece: YouTube video, webinar, or podcast (10-30 min)
  2. Extract 5-10 clips: Best moments, insights, quotes
  3. Reformat for each platform:
    • YouTube: Full video + Shorts
    • LinkedIn: Square clips with text overlay
    • TikTok: Vertical cuts with captions
    • Twitter: Horizontal clips with thread
  4. Schedule across 2-4 weeks: Don't post all at once
  5. Track what resonates: Double down on winners

Tools for Social Video Creation

Tool Best For Price
Descript Editing, auto-captions, repurposing $12-24/mo
Opus Clip AI clip extraction from long videos $15-40/mo
CapCut Quick mobile editing, TikTok-style Free
Canva Simple animations, thumbnails Free-$12/mo
Buffer/Later Scheduling across platforms $15-50/mo

Measuring Social Video Success

Metric What It Means Platform Focus
View count Reach (vanity metric mostly) All
Watch time Engagement quality YouTube, LinkedIn
Completion rate Content resonance All
Shares/Saves True value signal All
Profile visits Intent to learn more LinkedIn, Instagram
Website clicks Conversion potential LinkedIn, YouTube
